chunks: And indeed, your Lord will surely gather them together; indeed, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.
ai.seo_question: What are the divine attributes mentioned in the verse about God gathering people?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of the Ma'ad (Resurrection), framing it not merely as a display of power but as the culmination of divine Wisdom (Hakim) and comprehensive Knowledge ('Alim). It serves as a reassurance to the believers that the gathering is governed by perfect justice, reflecting the attribute of 'Adl (Justice) inherent in God's omniscience.
